title: docker stop and PID 1
statement: An image has `CMD ["python", "server.py"]` and server.py installs no signal handlers. You run `docker stop` on the container with the default options. What happens?
choices: Python receives SIGTERM, which is ignored because it runs as PID 1 with no handler; after 10 seconds Docker sends SIGKILL and the container exits with code 137
Python is terminated immediately by SIGTERM and the container exits with code 143
Docker sends SIGINT, Python raises KeyboardInterrupt and the container exits with code 130
The exec form starts Python under /bin/sh -c, which forwards SIGTERM, so Python exits at once with code 0
